text:
sam (sre): war room open  several customers reporting intermittent 5xx + high tail latency on hosted inference in ap-southeast-1 since ~22:10 UTC. I'm seeing elevated gateway errors and a few billing alerts. Can folks join?
nora (support): Tickets #4998, #5001, #5006. Customers report 502s and timeouts across generate and embeddings endpoints. One customer sent request IDs: r_3c7a, r_3c7b.
mina (oncall): grabbing metrics now. Edge shows spike in `upstream_read_timeout` and `502 while reading response header from upstream`. Backend pool shows increased request queue length and slow response times.
billing-bot: Billing alert: metering pipeline lag > 30m for hosted region ap-southeast-1. Affected invoices may be delayed.
alex (eng-runtime): Any recent model rollouts or quantization changes?
sam (sre): Not on hosted. But we had a regional infra maintenance earlier tonight for kernel updates that touched a subset of gateway nodes at 21:40 UTC.
diego (product): One enterprise customer also reported that retries resulted in double billing events; worried about refunds.
nora (support): Repro attempt from my laptop:
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-test' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/embedding-enc","input":"lorem ipsum","max_tokens":10}'
```
Result: connection established then `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` and zero body.
mina (oncall): Tailing gateway logs for the r_3c7a request: shows `upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream`, then `upstream_connect_timeout` for some retries. Backend trace shows worker threads hit a blocking syscall (epoll_wait) longer than usual.
alex (eng-runtime): Blocking syscall/hang could be worker thread pool exhaustion or a kernel networking limit. Any socket errors like EMFILE in the process logs?
sam (sre): Yes, I see `EMFILE: too many open files` in one of the router processes around 22:12:17; FD count jumping rapidly. Looks like a leak or too-tight ulimit.
nora (support): If it's EMFILE, that would explain 502s for incoming requests. Customers asking: will retries be safe? Right now retrying can amplify load.
diego (product): We should offer affected customers temporary credits and a comms note. Priors.
alex (eng-runtime): Immediate mitigation: 1) rotate gateway processes to clear FD leak and raise OS file descriptor limits, 2) enable connection-level backpressure to the busiest backend pools, 3) divert traffic from overloaded gateway nodes. I can push a rolling restart of gateway worker processes and bump limits.
mina (oncall): I'll cordon the 3 nodes with highest FD counts and shift traffic.
sam (sre): Also add a temporary global rate-limit for bulk or long-sequence jobs to prevent noisy-neighbor. We saw a single tenant with 1k concurrent long polling requests starting ~21:55.
nora (support): Customer X confirmed they ran a long embedding sweep starting at 21:50 — could be the triggering noisy neighbor.
alex (eng-runtime): Rolling restart in progress for gateway pods in ap-southeast-1. Command: `kubectl -n gateway rollout restart deployment/gateway --region=ap-southeast-1 --max-unavailable=1`
deploy-bot: rollout started by alex at 22:17 UTC.
sam (sre): Also applied ulimit bump on affected nodes: `ulimit -n 262144` and sysctl net.core.somaxconn increased.
mina (oncall): I'm seeing FD counts drop and errors declining. Gateway 5xx rate dips at 22:22.
billing-bot: Note: we observed duplicate metering events during retries between 22:05-22:20. Marking affected window for dedupe run.
nora (support): Customer B reports partial recovery at 22:25. Sending interim update and ask them to hold on aggressive retries.
diego (product): Action item: draft customer note + offer credit. I'll own messaging.
alex (eng-runtime): We captured a heap profile and FD list from gateway process pre-restart. Uploading to /artifacts/incidents/1815678901/. Preliminary suspicion: an external health-check client opened many idle connections that weren't properly cleaned up due to a keepalive bug in our proxy version.
sam (sre): So root causes look multi-factor: (1) noisy-neighbor bulk job in the region, (2) gateway process FD exhaustion/keepalive leak exacerbated by regional kernel maintenance resetting some networking timers, (3) metering pipeline duplications due to retries.
mina (oncall): Immediate follow-ups complete: restarts, ulimit bump, node cordon, temporary rate-limit. Monitoring for 30m.
alex (eng-runtime): Longer-term fixes proposed:
- upgrade proxy to patched version that fixes keepalive FD leak (alex) (due 2w)
- add per-tenant concurrency controls and queue depth signals in router (sam+eng-runtime) (due 3w)
- add metering dedupe window and idempotency for retrying client calls (billing + eng-api) (due 2w)
- improve canary for infra kernel updates to include socket-heavy synthetic tests (infra + eng-sre) (due 1w)
- add alert for process FD > 80% of soft limit sustained 2m (mina) (due 3d)
nora (support): I'll draft customer-facing FAQs and a template explaining safe retry patterns.
diego (product): I'll coordinate credits policy with finance; suggest automatic credit threshold for outages > 10m.
billing-bot: Metering dedupe job queued; estimated completion 03:00 UTC.
sam (sre): Logging mitigation timeline for postmortem: 22:10 observed errors; 22:12 identified FD exhaustion; 22:17 restart + ulimit bump; 22:22 error rate decline; 22:30 region stable.
mina (oncall): Downgraded severity to medium at 22:35 UTC.
nora (support): Final customer updates sent at 22:45.
alex (eng-runtime): Postmortem owners: alex + sam. Will include artifacts and profiling.
diego (product): Please tag me for the customer comms review.
sam (sre): Closing war room. If residual issues appear reopen this thread.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-0317-2210 closed at 23:00 UTC.
